instruction: A cinematic still with natural colors and a shallow depth of field captures a medium shot of four children standing in an outdoor park with green trees in the background. On the far left, the boy wearing glasses and a light yellow t-shirt (R3) stands with his right arm over the shoulder of the girl next to him, looking at the camera with a neutral, slightly serious expression. Next to him, the girl with curly hair tied up, wearing a white cardigan over a reddish-brown jumpsuit (R1), stands with her arms around the shoulders of the boys on either side, looking forward with a calm expression. The boy in the blue denim button-up shirt (R4) stands second from the right, smiling gently. On the far right, the girl with dark hair and bangs, wearing a dark blue cardigan over a striped dress (R2), leans her head slightly toward him with her arm around his waist, smiling warmly. Bright, warm sunlight filters through the trees from behind, creating a soft backlighting effect.

R1 has her arms around the shoulders of R3 and R4
